_why: Hand corrections to extracted question TEXT, each one read off the commission's own printed page at high resolution and recorded here rather than edited into the bank silently. Same principle as VERIFIED_KEYS.json: if a human overrode the machine, the override should be visible, attributable to a source page, and re-appliable after any re-extraction.
_how: apply_text_corrections.py matches on (source_pdf, number) and replaces only the named field.

corrections.source_page: 03_25_SET_A.pdf page 2, question 6 (rendered at 200 dpi and read by eye)
corrections.found_by: Rohan, during manual review of Set 1 question 22
corrections.problem: Latin letters embedded inside a Devanagari word — the extractor half-transliterated 'बेयरफुट' as 'बAREफुट' — plus 'टेक्नीशियन' rendered as 'तकनीशियन' and the tail of the sentence paraphrased.
corrections.was: किस मंत्रालय ने बAREफुट तकनीशियन (BFT) परियोजना शुरू की और इसके लिए किस उद्देश्य से इसे शुरू किया गया ?
corrections.now: किस मंत्रालय ने बेयरफुट टेक्नीशियन (BFT) परियोजना शुरू की और यह किस उद्देश्य से शुरू की गई थी ?

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve, Hindi route — it answered 'X' saying the country name in option B was mis-spelled, while both English routes answered B without noticing anything
corrections.problem: 'दक्षिण अफ्रीका' (South Africa) came out of the scan as 'दीक्षा अफ्रीका' — a real word, so no corruption-token list catches it, and the English side reads 'India-South Africa' perfectly. Invisible to every check we had, including the full Hindi read.

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve — answered the intended question correctly but flagged the wording
corrections.problem: The interrogative was dropped: 'At the rate percent per annum' is not a question. The key (12½%) is the answer to 'at WHAT rate percent per annum will a sum double in 8 years', which is plainly what was asked.
corrections.was: At the rate percent per annum simple interest, will a sum be double itself in 8 years?
corrections.now: At what rate percent per annum simple interest will a sum double itself in 8 years?

corrections.found_by: same — the Hindi lost the interrogative in the same way
corrections.problem: 'साधारण ब्याज की दर पर, क्या एक राशि 8 वर्षों में अपने आप को दोगुना कर देगी?' asks whether a sum doubles, not at what rate — a yes/no question with four percentages as options.
corrections.was: साधारण ब्याज की दर पर, क्या एक राशि 8 वर्षों में अपने आप को दोगुना कर देगी?
corrections.now: साधारण ब्याज की किस दर प्रतिशत वार्षिक पर कोई राशि 8 वर्षों में दोगुनी हो जाएगी ?

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve — all three routes rejected the keyed option because the portal name as printed is not a name any of them recognised
corrections.problem: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting's New Media Wing portal is 'NaViGate Bharat'. The scan produced 'NaVigat Bharat'. The Hindi option 'नविगेट भारत' is correct, so the two languages disagree and the English option names nothing that exists.

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve, Hindi route — named the right composer and then flagged the title
corrections.problem: Samudragupta's panegyric is the Prayāga PRAŚASTI (the Allahabad Pillar Inscription). 'Prayāga Prakāśa' is not a work. The keyed answer (Harishena) is correct for the Praśasti, so the question is sound once its subject is named properly.
corrections.was: Who composed the ‘Prayāga Prakāśa’ that praised the achievements of Samudragupta?
corrections.now: Who composed the ‘Prayāga Praśasti’ that praised the achievements of Samudragupta?

corrections.problem: Same wrong title in Hindi: 'प्रयाग प्रकाश' for प्रयाग प्रशस्ति.
corrections.was: किसने 'प्रयाग प्रकाश' की रचना की जो समुद्रगुप्त की उपलब्धियों की प्रशंसा करता है ?
corrections.now: किसने 'प्रयाग प्रशस्ति' की रचना की जो समुद्रगुप्त की उपलब्धियों की प्रशंसा करता है ?

corrections.problem: The composer's name in Hindi is हरिषेण; 'हरिशेना' is a back-transliteration of the English spelling.

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve, Hindi route — it answered D, and its reasoning shows why: it could not find 'divergent evolution' among the Hindi options
corrections.problem: Divergent evolution is अपसारी विकास. 'विभाजनात्मक विकास' means divisional/splitting evolution and is not the term — so the Hindi paper offers no correct answer while the English one reads perfectly. No cross-language check can see this: the option counts match, the numbers match, and the script is clean Devanagari.
Convergent evolution is अभिसारी विकास; 'संविलयन विकास' is not a term. As printed, the distractor was closer to correct than the answer.

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve, Hindi route — answered 'X', saying प्रतिलेखन was not on offer
corrections.problem: Transcription (DNA → RNA) is प्रतिलेखन. 'प्रतिलिपि' means a copy, which is if anything replication — the very next option. The Hindi answer was wrong while the English 'Transcription' was right.

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve, Hindi route — 'राम के अकेले काम करने के दो अलग समय दिए हैं; प्रश्न असंगत है'
corrections.problem: The second worker's name was lost: the Hindi names राम in BOTH sentences, so it states Ram paints the fence in 12 hours AND in 18 hours. Incoherent in Hindi, perfectly correct in English, and no cross-language check can see it — the numbers 12, 18 appear on both sides exactly as they should. (The Hindi sits in the record's  field, not  — the extraction's language labels are unreliable, see the script-routing note.)
corrections.was: राम अकेले एक बाड़ को 12 घंटे में बना सकता है। राम अकेले बाड़ को 18 घंटे में बना सकता है। यदि वे दोनों एक साथ काम करते हैं, तो पूरी बाड़ को बनाने में उन्हें कितना समय लगेगा?
corrections.now: राम अकेले एक बाड़ को 12 घंटे में बना सकता है। श्याम अकेले उसी बाड़ को 18 घंटे में बना सकती है। यदि वे दोनों एक साथ बिना रुके काम करें, तो पूरी बाड़ बनाने में उन्हें कितना समय लगेगा?

corrections.found_by: blind AI re-solve, Hindi route — across three runs it kept answering 'convergent', and its reasoning gave the game away: 'समानांग (analogous organs) अभिसारी विकास का संकेत देते हैं'
corrections.problem: Homologous organs are समजात अंग in Hindi. 'समानांग' reads as 'similar organ', which a Hindi student takes for ANALOGOUS — the opposite concept, and the exact distinction the question is testing. The English 'homologous' is unambiguous, so the two halves of the question ask different things.
corrections.was: समानांगों की उपस्थिति इंगित करती है :
corrections.now: समजात अंगों (homologous organs) की उपस्थिति इंगित करती है :
